summary: Seat drivers reconnect to a restarted daemon at spread times instead of all at once

replay.detail: No graph replay or projection change.

schema.detail: No database, registry or wire change.

compatibility.detail: No client, peer or harness contract change. A driver still retries until the daemon answers; only the pause between tries changes.

downtime.detail: Shorter for others, slightly longer for one seat: a seat's driver now waits between half a second and a second and a half, at random, before it reconnects its mailbox or retries a call the daemon could not take, instead of exactly one second. Drivers that lost the daemon together no longer reach it in the instant it starts to listen. Drivers pick this up when they re-execute into the new binary.

recovery.detail: Reverting restores the fixed one-second pause.
